findings.message: Entry param busca (filter:pessoasEquipe, persisted) has no state in the definition. Added public state busca (string | null, persisted in localStorage) that qryPessoasEquipe publishes and sends as the optional busca input.

selectedMembroEquipe has no query that fetches the record, and no setter. Added public selectMembroEquipe(id | null), the getter cadastroPessoa (row of the loaded list) and client.selectionInvalid handling.

cmdCadastrarPessoa and cmdSalvarAlteracoes have typed inputs but no <command>.input state. Added cmdCadastrarPessoaDraft (setCmdCadastrarPessoaDraft) and cmdSalvarAlteracoesDraft (setCmdSalvarAlteracoesDraft; prefilled from the selected row, carries id and version).

cmdCadastrarPessoa returns a person that is upserted at the end of the loaded list; the shared does not sort or check the busca filter, so order and filter membership may differ until the list is reloaded. pageStatus stays 'empty' if the list was empty before the first registration, because only the list load writes pageStatus.
public busca is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
